Create a striking festive display with this Pegdev LED Christmas reindeer, designed to bring a warm and welcoming glow to gardens, lawns, patios and entranceways throughout the Christmas season. Measuring 108 x 47 x 111cm, the generous freestanding design makes an eye-catching feature without overwhelming your outdoor space. For convenient everyday use, the decoration features a built-in 6 hour on / 18 hour off timer, allowing the lights to switch on automatically at the same time each day. The generous 5m leading cable provides added flexibility when positioning the reindeer around your outdoor Christmas display.
